prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1344; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss by phone from the insured driver. Reports a low-speed head-on collision at an intersection while traveling westbound. Both vehicles drivable from scene but one airbag deployed on the insured vehicle. Driver reports headache and dizziness, declined ambulance at scene. Photos requested from insured. Opened bodily injury and property damage features.

Entry 2: Spoke with the other driver's insurer. Their insured states vehicle sustained front bumper damage and hood misalignment. Claimant has retained counsel and all contact is to be routed through the attorney's office going forward. Requested medical authorization and prior treatment records through counsel. Assigned field appraiser to inspect both vehicles.

Entry 3: Appraisal completed on both vehicles. Insured vehicle has a deployed airbag, cracked radiator support, and damage to the front bumper cover. Estimate for repair has been prepared and submitted to the appraisal review desk. Counsel's office confirmed receipt of the bodily injury demand package and indicated treatment is ongoing. Diagnosis listed in records received includes concussion with post-concussive symptoms.

Entry 4: Reviewed medical records provided by counsel. Physician notes document mild traumatic brain injury consistent with concussion, with follow-up scheduled for neurology evaluation. Records indicate the claimant has missed several days of work. Requested wage verification and employer statement through counsel. Noted that the liability position is currently under review pending the police report and scene photos.

Entry 5: Police report obtained and reviewed. Report indicates the other driver crossed the centerline during a left turn, which supports a partial liability allocation toward that driver. Discussed status with counsel, who requested an updated demand after neurology results are in. Diary set for follow-up on medical treatment status. File remains open pending completion of property damage settlement and evaluation of the bodily injury claim.
